maya: Quick Q — where do I find time-to-first-token (TTFT) + p50/p95/p99 breakdowns and tokens/sec by route? Trying to debug higher p99s for a customer canary. Any dashboard links / quick queries? Thanks.

ashwin: Start with Grafana -> "Latency Explorer" dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/latency-explorer. For TTFT check the panels "TTFT by route" and "TTFT heatmap". Quick PromQL for p95 TTFT:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Tokens/sec per route:
```
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (route)
```

maya: awesome — do we have a Loki query to pull the first-token logs? want to tie cold-start traces to the high p99s.

ashwin: yup, Loki filter I usually use:
```
{app="runtime"} |= "first_token_generated" | json | route="/your-route"
```
Then correlate with Jaeger traces by trace_id field in the log. Jaeger search: https://jaeger.redwood.company/search (use trace_id from the log). Also check node-level tokens/sec in the "Throughput" dashboard if you suspect CPU/GPU throttling.

obs-bot: ALERT INFO — current p99 TTFT alert rule: `ALERT TTFTHigh_p99 WHEN histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, instance)) > 1200ms FOR 5m`. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.company/obs/ttft-runbook 

sam: For a canary I'd suggest two things: (1) narrow the p99 alert to production-critical routes only, (2) use a longer eval window to avoid noisy single-minute spikes. Example tweak (pseudo PromQL):
```
avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[1m])) by (route))[10m:]) > 1.2
```
That averages short bursts and is less noisy for canary traffic.

lina: I can run a 1h traffic capture against the canary and produce a temp panel that shows: TTFT p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec (route + host), and first-token log hits. Will post link when done.

maya: thanks! if someone can add the canary route to the p99 alert scope or create an ad-hoc dashboard that'd help. pinging @ashwin @lina :eyes: 

ashwin: will do — I'll add the route to the smoke alert group and spin up a temporary grafana panel tied to the canary. creating ticket OBS-5423 to track. :thumbsup: 

maya: perfect — saved the grafana/jaeger/loki links and will correlate logs/traces after lina's capture. I'll post findings here when I have them.
